panels.description: A reduced Halyard laboratory with empty benches. Suri tends a weakly pulsing living biofilter culture in its vial; leave upper lab space.
Alex connects a test power cycle while the culture falters. Keep the vial, connection and warning lights clear.
Suri cuts the power and shields the vial with both hands. Keep her hands and living culture dominant; leave upper space.
Suri carries the protected culture toward the laboratory door while Alex follows at a respectful distance. Leave upper doorway space.

items.speaker: SURI
items.text: Bring me a cycle that keeps it alive.
